posts.title: GrabMart data for faster disease outbreak detection
posts.description: Abstract Retail purchases can supplement clinical surveillance because changes in demand for some over-the-counter (OTC) products may appear before confirmed case reports. This article describes an early-stage concept for analysing aggregated GrabMart transaction data to identify unusual changes in product demand.
